info.title: Seam Universal API
info.description: Universal API for smart locks, access systems, thermostats, noise sensors, and related access-control workflows through Seam.

post.description: Creates a new connect webview in Seam.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

providerCategory.description: Provider category to show in the Connect Webview. Use `stable` for the broad sandbox-friendly path.

automaticallyManageNewDevices.description: Whether newly connected devices should be managed automatically. Seam defaults this to `true`.

waitForDeviceCreation.description: Whether the Connect Webview should wait for the first device sync before finishing. Seam defaults this to `false`.

acceptedCapabilities.description: Capability filters accepted by the webview.

acceptedDevices.description: Device IDs explicitly accepted by the webview.

acceptedProviders.description: Provider keys accepted by the webview.

anyDeviceAllowed.description: Whether any device can be selected.

anyProviderAllowed.description: Whether any provider can be selected.

automaticallyManageNewDevices.description: Whether newly connected devices are automatically managed.

connectedAccountId.description: Connected account ID after successful authorization.

customMetadata.description: Custom metadata attached to the webview.

customRedirectFailureUrl.description: Custom failure redirect URL when configured.

customRedirectUrl.description: Custom success redirect URL when configured.

deviceSelectionMode.description: Device selection mode for the webview.

loginSuccessful.description: Whether the authorization flow completed successfully.

selectedProvider.description: Provider selected during authorization when available.

status.description: Current status of the Connect Webview.

waitForDeviceCreation.description: Whether the flow waits for device creation before finishing.

workspaceId.description: Workspace ID that owns the Connect Webview.

get.description: Retrieves a list of noise sensors from Seam.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: connectedAccountId
parameters.description: ID of the connected account for which you want to list noise sensors.

schema.description: ID of the connected account for which you want to list noise sensors.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search string for noise sensors.

schema.description: Search string for noise sensors.

parameters.name: spaceId
parameters.description: ID of the space for which you want to list noise sensors.

schema.description: ID of the space for which you want to list noise sensors.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of records to return.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of records to skip before returning results.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

capabilitiesSupported.description: Capabilities supported by the noise sensor.

connectedAccountId.description: Connected account that owns the noise sensor.

customMetadata.description: Optional custom metadata for the noise sensor.

deviceId.description: Unique Seam device ID for the noise sensor.

deviceType.description: Noise sensor device type, such as `minut_sensor`.

displayName.description: Display name of the noise sensor.

errors.description: Errors associated with the noise sensor.

isManaged.description: Whether the noise sensor is managed by Seam.

location.description: Location details for the noise sensor.

properties.description: Noise sensor-specific properties such as battery, manufacturer, and current noise readings.

warnings.description: Warnings associated with the noise sensor.

workspaceId.description: Workspace that contains the noise sensor.
